mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO activity_event (member_id, event_type, event_time, payload_json, dedup_key) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{eventType}, NOW(), #{payloadJson}, #{dedupKey})

INSERT INTO activity_daily_agg (member_id, activity_date, key_name, count_value) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{activityDate}, #{keyName}, #{cnt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE count_value = count_value + VALUES(count_value)
INSERT INTO exp_grant_log (member_id, mission_id, granted_exp) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{missionId}, #{exp}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE member_id = member_id
